title: Low-Income Relief on Retail OTC Receipts by Household Income Band
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — income-band schedule for retail over-the-counter receipts.** The low-income relief share reduces the receipt allowance charge of a posted retail register receipt: the charge is multiplied by one minus the relief share, within the product and before the charge is limited to the allowance balance and rounded.

**Rule.** The low-income relief share is ten percent (0.1) where the active plan membership records household income at or below 138 percent of the federal poverty level, five percent (0.05) above 138 and at or below 185 percent, and nothing above 185 percent.

The income read is the household income, as a percent of the federal poverty level, recorded on the member's Medicaid Managed Care Membership in active status.

### Relief bands

| Household income on the active membership (percent of the federal poverty level) | Relief share | Charge multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| At or below 138 | 10 percent | 0.9 |
| Above 138, at or below 185 | 5 percent | 0.95 |
| Above 185 | Nothing | 1 |

### Band edges (hypothetical incomes)

| Recorded income | Relief share |
|---|---|
| 138 percent | 10 percent |
| 139 percent | 5 percent |
| 185 percent | 5 percent |
| 186 percent | Nothing |
